verdict.rationale: smolagents is an open-source local library where agent code, tool calls (Python/JSON), and traces (OpenTelemetry) are inherently in open formats, and agents/tools can be pushed to/from the Hub in shareable form, so there's no proprietary silo to 'leave.' However, there's no explicit documented 'export all your data' feature or bulk-export tooling. Missing for 10: an explicit data-export/portability feature, documentation framing this as user data ownership, and independent confirmation of full data portability.
